mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mrp_inventory_pool (batch_id, snapshot_id, factory_code, warehouse_code, inventory_org, material_code, available_qty, reserved_qty, warning_qty, allocated_qty, version) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{snapshotId}, #{factoryCode}, #{warehouseCode}, #{inventoryOrg}, #{materialCode}, #{availableQty}, #{reservedQty}, #{warningQty}, #{allocatedQty}, #{version})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM mrp_inventory_pool WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} ORDER BY factory_code, material_code
SELECT * FROM mrp_inventory_pool WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} ORDER BY factory_code, material_code, id LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mrp_inventory_pool WHERE batch_id=#{batchId}
SELECT * FROM mrp_inventory_pool WHERE batch_id=#{batchId} AND material_code=#{materialCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE mrp_inventory_pool p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.pool_id, COALESCE(SUM(a.allocated_qty), 0) AS allocated_qty FROM mrp_inventory_allocation a GROUP BY a.pool_id ) a ON a.pool_id = p.id SET p.allocated_qty=COALESCE(a.allocated_qty, 0), p.version=p.version+1 WHERE p.batch_id=#{batchId}
